transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a 600-kilogram shipment of battery-grade graphite powder staged at receiving this morning, and it's needed for the electrode-compounding run scheduled later this week. The supplier, product description, and quantity all match the purchase order. Before we can record any disposition, our plant policy requires quality, logistics, and environmental health and safety to each document their current release requirements and completion status. I'd like to go around and get each of your findings so we can determine whether this shipment gets a conditional release or a hold. Could each of you share your status?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Quality status: I completed the receiving sample test this morning. Moisture came in at 0.14%, which is below our internal maximum of 0.20%. The graphite release procedure requires samples from exactly 3 locations in the shipment, and I completed that check. However, I have not yet entered the results in the electronic lot record.

transcript.text: Logistics status: My carrier call this morning confirmed that the container seal number differs from the number on the shipping notice. I checked with our broker, and customs allows a conditional release only if this discrepancy is documented in a receiving exception record. I confirmed this with the broker this morning, but I have not yet filed that receiving exception record.
